2607.05876.method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.05876v1#S3 (five-dimensional resource account; optimistic max and no-overlap sum floors; wall ordering)
2607.05876.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.05876v1#S5 (DeepSeek-V3.2-style 671B MoE/MLA case study on 16 H20; concurrency-dependent TP/DP walls and reconciliation)
2607.05876.limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.05876v1#S5.SS6 (physical bounds are not achievable expectations; P50 service time diagnoses residual while P99 validates SLO; queueing is outside the resource floor)
2607.05876.artifact: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.05876v1#A1 (zero-dependency Python commands for floor and MBU/MFU calculations)
2607.05876.delta: Replace immediate grid search with a versioned resource vector for weight/KV bytes, FLOPs, communication bytes/messages and capacity; compute optimistic and no-overlap bounds, identify the first binding wall as load changes, compare observed steady-state service time against the bound, and open a profiler only when the residual is material.
2607.05876.source_claim: Replace immediate grid search with a versioned resource vector for weight/KV bytes, FLOPs, communication bytes/messages and capacity; compute optimistic and no-overlap bounds, identify the first binding wall as load changes, compare observed steady-state service time against the bound, and open a profiler only when the residual is material.
2607.05876.analysis_old: Full silicon sweeps were reasonable when configuration spaces were small and benchmark cost was acceptable. MoE, multiple parallelism layouts, long-context KV and topology-sensitive collectives make exhaustive deployment expensive and leave a slow number causally ambiguous.
2607.05876.analysis_tradeoff: The floor cheaply rejects impossible SLO/configurations and bounds potential overlap wins, but depends on calibrated bandwidth/latency and honest union/capacity assumptions. It excludes queueing and host/control-plane overhead; treating a lower bound as an achievable forecast, mixing P99 queueing with P50 engine residual, or carrying stale calibration across hardware/runtime revisions produces false diagnoses.

2607.05910.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.05910v1#S4 (Adaptive and held-out policy-shift splits, F1/PSS, latency); https://arxiv.org/html/2607.05910v1#A5 (rerun and breakdown details); https://arxiv.org/html/2607.05910v1#S5 (boundary-pair and training-branch ablations)

2607.05910.delta: Treat moderation as a relation between content evidence and a versioned runtime policy, not an intrinsic image label. Randomize policy presentation to remove slot shortcuts, then train matched same-image pass/block pairs so the decision must change when the authoritative boundary changes.
2607.05910.source_claim: Treat moderation as a relation between content evidence and a versioned runtime policy, not an intrinsic image label. Randomize policy presentation to remove slot shortcuts, then train matched same-image pass/block pairs so the decision must change when the authoritative boundary changes.
2607.05910.analysis_old: A fixed safe/unsafe detector was reasonable under one product taxonomy. Multi-product, jurisdictional and runtime policy changes break that assumption: identical evidence can legitimately map to different decisions.
2607.05910.analysis_tradeoff: Explicit policy input enables rapid policy changes and auditability, but wording, taxonomy, localization and held-out policy composition become model inputs that can drift. PSS detects paired flips but does not prove legal correctness, multilingual coverage, adversarial robustness or deployment authority; deterministic gateway/tool policy remains authoritative.

2607.06118.method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06118v1#S3 (1,550 tasks / 800 live sites; three protocols; NavEval inputs task, URLs/requests, actions and final screenshot)
2607.06118.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06118v1#S4 (controlled Playwright runs, six agent families, human success and judge agreement); https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06118v1#Pt0.A3.SS4 (judge-backbone and request-filtering ablations)
2607.06118.limitations: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no dedicated limitations section; live-site drift, restricted search, LLM-judge dependence and binary success aggregation bound the claims
2607.06118.delta: Evaluate a web agent using a richer execution record than a final screenshot: collect action sequence, navigation URLs and network requests, filter/restructure them, and let a versioned judge classify success against a human reference. Separate navigation, knowledge-assisted navigation and end-to-end extraction protocols.
2607.06118.source_claim: Evaluate a web agent using a richer execution record than a final screenshot: collect action sequence, navigation URLs and network requests, filter/restructure them, and let a versioned judge classify success against a human reference. Separate navigation, knowledge-assisted navigation and end-to-end extraction protocols.
2607.06118.analysis_old: Final screenshots and brittle rules were cheap and reproducible for narrow sites. Live, dynamic pages and long workflows make final-state evidence incomplete and hand-maintained rules costly.
2607.06118.analysis_tradeoff: Richer traces improve judge agreement and diagnosis but increase collection cost, privacy exposure and dependence on browser/network instrumentation. Live-site drift harms repeatability; judge agreement is not task truth, and restricting search changes the workload contract.

2607.06624.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.06624v1#page=7 (judge validation, 32-trajectory Java fold, leaderboard and pairwise reports); https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.06624v1#page=10 (quality-index behavior, judge/reviewer analyses and correlation study; not a component ablation of an agent)
2607.06624.limitations: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.06624v1#page=12 (Java-only task class, third-party API/version/latency control, compact folds and evaluator limits)
2607.06624.artifact: https://github.com/agent-lens/agent-lens-bench/tree/d152ae841e61279af6695c66c4a3625f96495199 (repository explicitly disclosed by exact v1; latest commit at the Daily cutoff, 2026-07-07T11:47:58Z)
2607.06624.delta: Make the complete coding-agent trajectory and final repository state the evaluation subject. Combine task-specific executable verifiers with metric-specific judge narratives that cite exact trajectory evidence, then aggregate without collapsing outcome, instruction compliance, workflow pitfalls, tool use and user-facing quality into one unexplained score.
2607.06624.source_claim: Make the complete coding-agent trajectory and final repository state the evaluation subject. Combine task-specific executable verifiers with metric-specific judge narratives that cite exact trajectory evidence, then aggregate without collapsing outcome, instruction compliance, workflow pitfalls, tool use and user-facing quality into one unexplained score.
2607.06624.analysis_old: Unit tests or final patch success were reasonable for isolated coding tasks. Interactive agents can claim success despite failed checks, damage unrelated files, loop on tools or violate process constraints while still producing a superficially plausible final diff.
2607.06624.analysis_tradeoff: Trajectory review improves attribution and exposes misleading completion, but uses small production-like folds, simulated personas and model judges. Formal checks can be incomplete and judges correlated with evaluated models; a composite QI is decision support, not ground truth. The disclosed repository improves inspectability, but the compact Java fold, simulated personas, model-judge correlation and third-party runtime drift still bound reproduction and generalization.

2607.06291.delta: A proposed full-stack route combines autoregressive video generation with explicit camera/geometry cache, compressed history, rollout-error replay and distilled sampling to pursue long-horizon playable worlds.
2607.06291.source_claim: A proposed full-stack route combines autoregressive video generation with explicit camera/geometry cache, compressed history, rollout-error replay and distilled sampling to pursue long-horizon playable worlds.
2607.06291.analysis_old: Short open-loop clips tolerate repeated full context and weak persistent geometry. Interactive long horizons require bounded state, camera-consistent disocclusion and accumulated-error control under real-time latency.
2607.06291.analysis_tradeoff: Geometry cache improves static consistency but struggles with dynamic objects and depends on estimated depth; history compression forgets causal state; an error bank may regularize recurring artifacts without proving recovery from novel drift. The event-time v1 does not close implementation/evaluation evidence.

2607.06519.method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06519v1#S3 (adjacent-layer DCT-style low-frequency sharing, sparse high-frequency residuals, per-head shared/residual/exact routing from prefill probes)
2607.06519.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06519v1#S4 (32K QA/retrieval/summarization/code metrics plus throughput, TTFT and peak KV memory); https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06519v1#S5 (factorization, residual, routing, reconstruction loss, exact fallback and block-size variants)
2607.06519.limitations: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no dedicated limitations section; model/checkpoint, hardware, precision, batch/concurrency and production-serving integration are not sufficiently disclosed for portable performance claims
2607.06519.artifact: Not Disclosed — no author repository or immutable implementation artifact is linked in exact v1
2607.06519.delta: Exploit adjacent-layer correlation without assuming uniform redundancy: share low-frequency depth components, retain sparse layer-specific residuals, and route each head among shared, residual and exact cache modes using prompt-local attention-logit reconstruction evidence.
2607.06519.source_claim: Exploit adjacent-layer correlation without assuming uniform redundancy: share low-frequency depth components, retain sparse layer-specific residuals, and route each head among shared, residual and exact cache modes using prompt-local attention-logit reconstruction evidence.
2607.06519.analysis_old: Uniform depth sharing is simple and compact but erases rare layer-specific retrieval evidence. Full KV remains robust but scales memory and bandwidth with layers, length and concurrency.
2607.06519.analysis_tradeoff: Adaptive exact fallback protects sensitive heads at the cost of prefill probing, mixed layouts and specialized kernels. Probe error or workload drift can assign unsafe modes; reported throughput lacks a complete portable hardware/concurrency contract, and no artifact proves integration with continuous batching/prefix reuse.

2607.06523.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06523v1#S4 (16K-128K retrieval slices; main 64K greedy-512 protocol; quality, memory, TTFT, throughput, perplexity and reconstruction error); https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06523v1#S5 (basis sharing, token router, residual reconstruction/gates and fused-kernel ablations)
2607.06523.limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06523v1#S7 (single compressed layout; batching, prefix reuse, PD disaggregation and multi-tenant pools left open); no standalone limitations section
2607.06523.artifact: Not Disclosed — no author repository or immutable CUDA implementation is linked in exact v1
2607.06523.delta: Represent neighboring-layer K/V with shared low-rank bases, then allocate token-specific residual rank from online attention-output error rather than a uniform cache budget; fuse basis lookup, residual dequantization and projection to avoid returning all savings as decode overhead.
2607.06523.source_claim: Represent neighboring-layer K/V with shared low-rank bases, then allocate token-specific residual rank from online attention-output error rather than a uniform cache budget; fuse basis lookup, residual dequantization and projection to avoid returning all savings as decode overhead.
2607.06523.analysis_old: Layer-only sharing ignores token heterogeneity; token eviction ignores depth correlation. Long-context retrieval needs both axes because instruction/entity tokens and deeper semantic states have different fidelity needs.
2607.06523.analysis_tradeoff: Two-dimensional adaptive layouts improve the quality-memory search space but add online probes, residual metadata and fused-kernel coupling. Reconstruction error is a proxy, not future causal utility. Event-time evidence does not establish prefix-sharing, batching, multi-tenant or disaggregated compatibility.

2607.06559.method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06559v1#S3 (projective RGB/depth/flow representation, tri-branch diffusion and single-forward predictive-feature policy)
2607.06559.evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06559v1#S4 (50 held-out video sequences; six real-robot tasks, 35 consecutive trials/task, 120s success bound, TIANJI M6/WUJI HAND/D435i); https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06559v1#S4.SS4 (modality/representation and policy component ablations)
2607.06559.limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.06559v1#S5 (about 9Hz on RTX 5090; egocentric optimization; multi-view/multi-robot open)
2607.06559.delta: Co-generate appearance, depth and optical flow so predictive state carries geometry and motion, then expose internal predictive features to a one-forward policy instead of placing iterative video denoising on every action step. The generated world branch and control branch share representation but have different latency and authority contracts.
2607.06559.source_claim: Co-generate appearance, depth and optical flow so predictive state carries geometry and motion, then expose internal predictive features to a one-forward policy instead of placing iterative video denoising on every action step. The generated world branch and control branch share representation but have different latency and authority contracts.
2607.06559.analysis_old: 2D video priors scale well but force control to infer geometry/motion from pixels and often repeatedly denoise. Explicit 3D simulators provide geometry but can be scene-specific, multi-view dependent and harder to scale. Closed-loop dexterous control adds a roughly 10Hz deadline.
2607.06559.analysis_tradeoff: Projective 4D state improves geometric/motion observability while remaining tied to camera calibration and pseudo-label quality. The policy bypass reduces critical-path latency but its internal feature is not an authoritative world state; 9Hz on RTX 5090 remains task-specific, and 35 trials/task do not prove open-world generalization or safety.

2607.06560.source_claim: Convert heterogeneous annotations into a shared sample contract—visual inputs, natural-language task/schema instruction, and a text/image/mixed response that can be deterministically decoded back into boxes, masks, dense maps or camera records—so one generative model can learn many vision tasks without task-specific heads.
2607.06560.analysis_old: Specialist heads and losses are efficient and strongly typed for one task. Scaling many vision capabilities creates separate architecture, training and deployment contracts; a unified generator reduces those interfaces but moves typing into prompts, reserved tokens, parsers and evaluation adapters.
2607.06560.analysis_tradeoff: A shared generative interface improves reuse and cross-task transfer but does not erase modality-specific semantics. Parser/schema drift, invalid outputs, coordinate quantization, pseudo-label provenance and capability interference become first-class state. Specialists remain preferable for strict latency, calibrated dense output or safety-critical geometry.

2607.05721.delta: Move uncertainty from token noise or one sequence score to typed semantic spans, distilling multi-sample claim support into a single-pass probe while preserving an explicit external-verification boundary.
2607.05721.source_claim: The paper shows that a model-specific white-box probe can jointly identify semantic spans and rank uncertainty under its factual-English benchmark; it does not turn probe output into truth probability or remove deployment-slice calibration.
2607.05721.analysis_old: Token entropy was cheap but semantically fragmented; sequence uncertainty captured semantic disagreement but could not localize which claim required evidence and multiplied inference cost.

Low predicted uncertainty can still be confidently wrong, so calibrated risk-coverage and evidence verification remain authoritative.

books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Move uncertainty from token noise or one sequence score to typed semantic spans, distilling multi-sample claim support into a single-pass probe while preserving an explicit external-verification boundary. Preserve this boundary: The learned probe adds training/label cost, requires internal states and separate probes per backbone, and inherits judge/Wikipedia/domain bias. Low predicted uncertainty can still be confidently wrong, so calibrated risk-coverage and evidence verification remain authoritative.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: The paper shows that a model-specific white-box probe can jointly identify semantic spans and rank uncertainty under its factual-English benchmark; it does not turn probe output into truth probability or remove deployment-slice calibration.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从直接 Grid Search 到 Floor-first Diagnosis
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Replace immediate grid search with a versioned resource vector for weight/KV bytes, FLOPs, communication bytes/messages and capacity; compute optimistic and no-overlap bounds, identify the first binding wall as load changes, compare observed steady-state service time against the bound, and open a profiler only when the residual is material. Preserve this boundary: The floor cheaply rejects impossible SLO/configurations and bounds potential overlap wins, but depends on calibrated bandwidth/latency and honest union/capacity assumptions. It excludes queueing and host/control-plane overhead; treating a lower bound as an achievable forecast, mixing P99 queueing with P50 engine residual, or carrying stale calibration across hardware/runtime revisions produces false diagnoses.

books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Treat real-time world-model deployment as joint state and runtime design: bound persistent history by semantic retrieval, train the causal student on its own rollout distribution, and co-design residency/parallelism/kernels around streaming latency. Preserve this boundary: Selected latent history can omit causal state; self-forcing may regularize only seen rollout errors; on-demand loading and NPU-specific kernels exchange portability for memory/latency. Visual quality and FPS do not establish controller utility or safety.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: Authors report a 14B MoE video world model with history selection, few-step causal distillation and NPU execution optimizations under their visual/system benchmark; this does not prove an action-sufficient causal environment model.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从 Skill Postcondition 到 Next-skill Readiness Contract
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Separate skill-local success from compositional readiness: a completed skill must establish both its own postcondition and a typed admission predicate for the next skill under the actual chained terminal state. Preserve this boundary: Readiness checks add verifier latency, schema work and false reject/accept modes; VLM verification is not physical truth. Clean skill tests remain useful component tests, but cannot substitute for chained-state and recovery evaluation.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: The authors show a large clean-snapshot versus chained-rollout gap for the same checkpoints and trace failures to readiness/grounding/control under a small BEHAVIOR-1K pilot; they do not estimate population failure rates or prove the proposed next-skill predicate.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: Calibration Slice 必须包含 Language × Model Scale × Estimator Contract
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Make uncertainty calibration slice-aware not only by domain, but by generation language, model scale/family and estimator access contract; method rankings can reverse across these slices. Preserve this boundary: English reasoning can improve measured UE while violating user-language requirements; self-verbalized confidence remains model/training sensitive. MCQA removes judge bias from labels but does not validate long-form factual claims.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: The authors report multilingual MCQA correlations under their nine-model/22-language contract; results concern correctness discrimination of elicited reasoning and do not establish open-ended factual calibration.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从“Latent 有信息”到 Reachability、Admission 与 Assignment
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Decompose representation claims into reachability, admission and assignment: a direction can be observable yet absent from the latent, admitted by an objective yet duplicated elsewhere, or carried by a different eligible route than removal-cost intuition predicts. Preserve this boundary: More supervision dimensions and latent-only heads improve admission but consume capacity and can install proxy directions without causal meaning. Linear probes reveal decodability, not controller use; assignment requires intervention and route-specific tests.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: Synthetic and trained-model experiments support an objective-rank bottleneck and route-specific readout under the paper setup; they do not prove a universal nonlinear representation theorem or open-world causal sufficiency.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从 Temporal Warm Start 到带 Admission 的 Action Memoization
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Move warm-starting from same-episode temporal continuity to versioned output retrieval: reuse a prior action chunk only when an action-relevant multimodal key passes admission, refine it for a bounded number of flow steps, otherwise fall back to the base policy. Preserve this boundary: Cache hit thresholds trade latency against unsafe aliasing; compact keys can hide object pose, calibration or contact differences. Cache identity must bind observation/proprioception/action schema/policy revision, and controller/safety checks retain execution authority.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: Authors report action-head latency/success trade-offs for pi_0.5 and GR00T-N1.6 on their simulation and real-robot contracts; they do not prove cached actions remain safe under unseen state aliasing or environment change.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从 Trajectory Count 到 Primitive × Transition Coverage
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Replace trajectory-count coverage with reusable-structure coverage: allocate budget over primitive compositions and transition interfaces under diminishing returns, then choose stable representatives within each structural bucket. Preserve this boundary: Structure discovery adds encoder/clustering/version identity and may discard rare but important failures as outliers. Fixed gripper flips miss non-grasp boundaries; medoids favor imitation stability over robustness. Full data remains preferable when structure estimates are unreliable.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: Authors report that SIEVE-selected subsets can outperform full-data training in their VLA/simulator contracts; they do not establish that discovered clusters are true skills or that central trajectories cover safety-critical tails.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从统一跨层共享到 Token × Depth 自适应残差
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Exploit adjacent-layer correlation without assuming uniform redundancy: share low-frequency depth components, retain sparse layer-specific residuals, and route each head among shared, residual and exact cache modes using prompt-local attention-logit reconstruction evidence. Preserve this boundary: Adaptive exact fallback protects sensitive heads at the cost of prefill probing, mixed layouts and specialized kernels. Probe error or workload drift can assign unsafe modes; reported throughput lacks a complete portable hardware/concurrency contract, and no artifact proves integration with continuous batching/prefix reuse.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从统一跨层共享到 Token × Depth 自适应残差
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Represent neighboring-layer K/V with shared low-rank bases, then allocate token-specific residual rank from online attention-output error rather than a uniform cache budget; fuse basis lookup, residual dequantization and projection to avoid returning all savings as decode overhead. Preserve this boundary: Two-dimensional adaptive layouts improve the quality-memory search space but add online probes, residual metadata and fused-kernel coupling. Reconstruction error is a proxy, not future causal utility. Event-time evidence does not establish prefix-sharing, batching, multi-tenant or disaggregated compatibility.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从 Physical Teleoperation 到带 Provenance 的 Digital Teleoperation Data

adjacent_refs.section: 数据演进：从专用演示到多来源对齐

books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Decouple operator time from physical robot recording by driving an action-conditioned video world model with human hand poses, retargeting the pose stream to a robot schema and treating the generated egocentric sequence plus action label as a derived training trajectory. Preserve this boundary: Digital teleoperation moves the gap into generative fidelity, pose/depth reconstruction, retargeting and per-embodiment fine-tuning. Derived trajectories need model/version/provenance tags and real closed-loop admission; real teleoperation remains necessary for calibration and contact tails.
books_patch_queue.source_claim: Authors report policy gains from mixed real and generated data and feasibility of synthetic-only transfer on their tasks; they do not prove the generated video is a physically valid transition or that one model transfers across robot kinematics without adaptation.

adjacent_refs.section: 从 RGB Rollout 到 Projective 4D Predictive State

books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Co-generate appearance, depth and optical flow so predictive state carries geometry and motion, then expose internal predictive features to a one-forward policy instead of placing iterative video denoising on every action step. The generated world branch and control branch share representation but have different latency and authority contracts. Preserve this boundary: Projective 4D state improves geometric/motion observability while remaining tied to camera calibration and pseudo-label quality. The policy bypass reduces critical-path latency but its internal feature is not an authoritative world state; 9Hz on RTX 5090 remains task-specific, and 35 trials/task do not prove open-world generalization or safety.

books_patch_queue.integration_section: 从 Specialist Head 到 Typed Unified Generation
books_patch_queue.suggested_patch: Convert heterogeneous annotations into a shared sample contract—visual inputs, natural-language task/schema instruction, and a text/image/mixed response that can be deterministically decoded back into boxes, masks, dense maps or camera records—so one generative model can learn many vision tasks without task-specific heads. Preserve this boundary: A shared generative interface improves reuse and cross-task transfer but does not erase modality-specific semantics. Parser/schema drift, invalid outputs, coordinate quantization, pseudo-label provenance and capability interference become first-class state. Specialists remain preferable for strict latency, calibrated dense output or safety-critical geometry.
